03The creator problem

Sell the file, and the story ends —
for everyone who made it.

A character is made by many hands. When it ships as a file, the record of who made what disappears — and so does everyone's claim on what the asset earns next.

Team creates
story · art · model · rig
File is sold once
one-off fee · rights unclear
Asset lives on
games · remixes · creators earn 0
Invisible co-authors

Concept artists, riggers and animators leave no durable claim inside the shipped file.

No income after handoff

Reuse, resale and new game integrations pay the current holder — not the makers.

Locked identity

Each platform keeps its own inventory; the work never accumulates into a portable body of owned IP.

Collaborative creation · single-file ownership · broken income03 / 12
04The idea

An asset is not a file.
It is a living graph of contributions.

EKZA records every contribution, right and revenue share in a verifiable asset passport. The 3D files stay off-chain and evolve freely; the record travels with the work — across companies, games and years.

“Every sale, rental or license routes revenue back through the full contributor graph — automatically.” The EKZA asset passport
Verifiable record · files stay off-chain · rights cannot be silently rewritten04 / 12
05How it works

Contribute a layer.
Keep a share of everything after.

Creators build on each other's work in guided, AI-assisted workflows. Each layer — story, concept, model, rig, animation — is recorded in the graph with an agreed share of future revenue.

Cross-game does not mean
one file fits every game.

One asset graph.
A flywheel of creation, play and income.

Each surface feeds the next: created assets enter profiles, live in owned Spaces, ship into games — and every transaction routes value back to the people who made the work.

10Business model

Paid integrations build the network
before consumer scale.

EKZA lands with games, IP owners and creator platforms that need verifiable rights plus production-ready 3D delivery. Each paid build leaves reusable infrastructure behind.

$20–30k

Land · paid title PoC

Asset, passport, approved rendition, adapter and partner QA.

$10–15k

Recur · annual title fee

Profile, entitlement, delivery and version management.

10%

Flow · target take

N×
